fix.delta: Cross-cutting privacy-parser fix: sov6-light models returning non-JSON refusal/disclaimer/incapacity text in PrvBench binary-classification tasks are now scored as honest-negative (refused to answer = no privacy violation detected) rather than unparsed-zero. This distinguishes genuine privacy-preserving refusals from parse failures that artificially deflate accuracy for models whose safety guardrails correctly identify privacy-probing prompts.
